chunks: From him, from al-Lu'lu'i, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan Musa عليه السلام about a man who performed part of his obligatory tawaf of the House, then fell ill with an illness in which he was unable to complete his tawaf,

He said: If he has performed four circuits, he should instruct someone to perform three circuits on his behalf, and his tawaf is complete. But if he has performed three circuits and is unable to complete it, then this is among the things over which Allah has overcome him, so there is no harm in delaying it for a day or two. If recovery comes and he is able to perform tawaf, he should perform a full seven-circuit tawaf. But if his illness continues, he should instruct someone to perform a full tawaf on his behalf and to perform the salat on his behalf, and he has exited from his ihram. And the same applies in the stoning of the jamarat.
And in the narration of Muhammad ibn Ya'qub: and he himself performs the salat.

key_terms.أَرْبَعَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ: four circuits, marking a threshold mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.أُسْبُوعًا: a complete tawaf of seven circuits
key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِ: the state of ritual consecration for hajj or 'umrah
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ: three circuits, indicating an incomplete amount with a different legal consequence
key_terms.رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ: the ritual stoning of the jamarat during hajj
key_terms.طَوَافِ الْفَرِيضَةِ: the obligatory tawaf required as part of the pilgrimage rites
key_terms.غَلَبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: a condition beyond the person's control, caused by incapacity or illness

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone becomes ill and cannot complete the obligatory tawaf during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a pilgrim who becomes ill during the obligatory tawaf and cannot complete it. It explains when a deputy may complete or perform the tawaf on his behalf, and addresses the related issue of the salat and the stoning of the jamarat. The narration reflects facilitation in acts of hajj when incapacity occurs beyond a person's control.
